mentions.name: Linux audio workstation migration
mentions.description: This project migrates a music production setup back to Linux now that the PipeWire transition has ended the fragmented ALSA+JACK+Pulse+PipeWire audio stack.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still about 75% done switching back to linux, now that I feel it's finally ready to be used for music stuff since the transition to Pipewire seems over with and It's no longer a total mess of ALSA+JACK+Pulse+PipeWire.
